notes: Much smarter laptop part finding. It no longer just searches the model name (which threw up chargers and keyboards) — it now matches the laptop to its actual panel/battery part numbers and searches those, so you get the right screen straight away. 'Find for THIS PC' resolves your machine to its compatible panels and prices them all at once, cheapest first, so you can pick the best-value compatible one. New 'Manufacturer (direct)' supplier that links to the brand's own parts site — and for Dell it deep-links to your exact machine by its service tag. Optional eBay developer keys (set them under ⚙ Suppliers) turn on reliable live eBay prices via eBay's official API; without them eBay stays a best-effort read.
